title: Cardinal size of a scheme
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $\mathcal B(Z)$ be its set of affine open subsets, each with its induced open subscheme structure, and let $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Z)$ be the ring of sections of its structure sheaf on $U$. Define the cardinal size of $Z$ by $s(Z)=\max\{\aleph_0,|\mathcal B(Z)|,\sup_{U\in\mathcal B(Z)}|\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Z)|\}$. The empty scheme is allowed.
